news.summary_en: Can AI help improve India’s power distribution utilities? An original survey of utilities in Tamil Nadu and Odisha finds that strong digital infrastructure, interoperable data, and in-house capacity will determine whether AI can deliver results at scale.

news.title: Strength in Unity: Climate Action for the Pacific Islands
news.summary_en: Pacific Island countries have turned collective diplomacy into global climate influence—but there are limits to this approach without greater global support.

news.title: Transshipment Crackdowns Won’t Fix the U.S.-China Trade Imbalance
news.summary_en: The White House alleges that Chinese exports are being rerouted through third countries to circumvent U.S. tariffs. By analyzing transshipment activity and substantive supply chain shifts, CSIS challenges this diagnosis and highlights persistent structural issues.

news.title: What Latin America Can Teach the United States about Drone Defense
news.summary_en: The CSIS Americas Program analyzes opportunities for the United States to cooperate with partners in Latin America to combat nonstate drone threats.

news.title: Fast Following: Military Emulation and Twenty-First-Century Transformation
news.summary_en: Modern war is a contest of learning and adaptation, and the lessons travel in a matter of weeks. Fast following, or copying, improving, and fielding proven innovations at speed, is now a core competency, yet Western militaries remain slow to build it.
